compiled_state.title: RED test: dedup extensions for findings.py (line-range overlap, MAX-severity, dual-rationale)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: seeded fixture with overlapping region findings asserts dedup with MAX-severity reconciliation and dual-rationale preservation in the merged-rationale field

## TDD Requirement
Write a new test file `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_region_dedup.py` asserting:
1. `deduplicate_region_findings()` merges two findings with overlapping line ranges in the same (file, dimension) bucket
2. When severities differ, the MAX severity is kept and both rationales appear in a `merged_rationale` field
3. When severities are equal, findings are merged without a `merged_rationale` duplication
4. A claim-fingerprint (SHA-256 of lowercased, whitespace-normalized claim text) match always deduplicates regardless of line-range proximity

These tests MUST fail (RED) before T2 implements `deduplicate_region_findings()` in findings.py.

## Test Approach
Given: two findings dicts representing different region reviewers — same file, overlapping line ranges [10,20] and [15,25], same dimension, different severities (critical vs important)
When: `deduplicate_region_findings([finding_a, finding_b])` is called
Then: returns a single finding with severity=critical (MAX), and a `merged_rationale` field containing both original rationale texts

RED marker: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_region_dedup.py [test_max_severity_reconciliation_with_dual_rationale]

## Implementation Notes
- `deduplicate_region_findings(findings: list[dict]) -> list[dict]` is the new function to be added to `dso_ci_review/findings.py` in T2
- Line-range overlap matching: two findings overlap when their line ranges intersect (not exact-match). Represent line range as (start, end) parsed from `cited_lines` strings of form `path:start-end` or `path:line`.
- Claim-fingerprint = `hashlib.sha256(claim.lower().split().join(' ').encode()).hexdigest()` — built from `description` field, whitespace-normalized
- Dedup key: (file, dimension, claim-fingerprint) with overlap check as secondary bucket trigger for same (file, dimension) pairs
- `merged_rationale` field: `{"primary": <higher_sev_rationale>, "secondary": <lower_sev_rationale>}` dict — only present when severities differ

## Pattern Reference
# from plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/findings.py:103-137
# merge_findings() uses additive combine + min-score merge as baseline pattern
# New deduplicate_region_findings() uses MAX-severity + overlap bucket logic instead

## Acceptance Criteria

  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_region_dedup.py` exists
  Verify: test -f $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_region_dedup.py
- [ ] Tests FAIL before T2 implementation (RED confirmed)
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_region_dedup.py 2>&1 | grep -qE "ImportError|AttributeError|FAILED"
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED marker `[test_max_severity_reconciliation_with_dual_rationale]` for `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/findings.py`
  Verify: grep '\[test_max_severity_reconciliation_with_dual_rationale\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Test file is fuzzy-match compatible with findings.py (normalized: "findingspy" is substring of "testregiondedup.py" — NOT matching, so .test-index entry is required)
  Verify: grep -q 'dso_ci_review/findings.py' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
